description: Version-controlled Directus extension manifest. Lists every extension that QA, build and release must discover, test and package. The first entry is the bulk-mutation endpoint (B2); G3 adds vibetable-workspace-index. Tools iterate this list rather than hard-coding a single extension name.

extensions.name: vibetable-bulk-mutation
extensions.description: Atomic server-side bulk mutation endpoint with idempotency keys and permission enforcement.

extensions.name: vibetable-workspace-index
extensions.description: Workspace index endpoint: idempotent revision publish, document link/unlink, and expected-head CAS reconcile.
